T.title: Listen to Every Neighbor
T.p1: Tap each neighbor to hear what they hope and what they worry about.
T.p2: Find two neighbors who want the same thing. Read each hope and each worry: a worry shows what someone wants, too. Tap one neighbor, then another.
T.picked: Picked. Now tap one more neighbor.
T.noplan: These two don't share one of the 4 wishes here. Do you see something else they share? Talk about it with someone. Then try another pair.
T.all: And one wish everyone shares: to be heard.
T.p3: Tap the neighbor who said it.
T.can: I can listen to every neighbor before I make up my mind.
T.tipPairs: Next time, read each neighbor's hope and worry before you tap.
T.tipWish: Next time, try more pairs. Most neighbors share something.
T.tipLine: Next time, read each hope and worry slowly.
T.tip100: Great listening! Try a new round.
T.real: Ask someone at home: 'What do you hope for our neighborhood?' Listen to the whole answer.

bank.b0001: I hope ambulances can always reach the clinic fast.
bank.b0002: I worry the big backup engines could make smoky air. I want to know how often they run.
bank.b0003: I hope my grandkids can farm this land too.
bank.b0004: I worry mud could reach the creek and my well.
bank.b0005: I hope there are good jobs here for people who live here.
bank.b0006: I worry the jobs will end when the building is done.
bank.b0007: I hope my grandson can find good work here.
bank.b0008: I worry old graves could be hidden on the farm. I want someone to look before digging.
bank.b0009: I hope new workers come to my bakery, so I can hire more people.
bank.b0010: I worry big trucks will crowd Main Street for months.
bank.b0011: I hope our school gets tech classes, so students can work in tech here someday.
bank.b0012: I worry young people will move away to find work.
bank.b0013: I hope the clinic always has power, even in big storms.
bank.b0014: I worry bright lights all night could shine into bedrooms.
bank.b0015: I hope my cows and fields stay healthy.
bank.b0016: I worry no one will test my well before they dig.
bank.b0017: I hope I can teach young people here to be electricians.
bank.b0018: I worry the creek could get muddy. I fish there with my kids.
bank.b0019: I hope we keep the old chapel and the stories of this land.
bank.b0020: I worry my power bill will go up.
bank.b0021: I hope new workers come to eat on Main Street.
bank.b0022: I worry the rent for my shop will go up while they build.
bank.b0023: I hope we keep the big pecan trees where we play.
bank.b0024: I worry a hum at night could keep my little sister awake.
bank.b0025: Take care of the land, water and air
bank.b0026: Good jobs for people who live here
bank.b0028: Kids can grow up and stay in Pecan Grove
bank.b0029: Clean water in the creek and our wells
bank.b0031: Fair costs for families and shops
bank.b0032: Keep the trees, fields and old places
